review.gallery: Eight genuine project images selected from the developer brochure and project gallery. Exterior scenes and master plan align with the Greenz documentation.
review.location: Original regional map and all 12 journey estimates verified visually on brochure page 4. Madena’s location point agrees within the same parcel vicinity as PropRealm’s listing point. The PropRealm registry match is unrelated and was excluded.
review.floorPlans: All 18 sheets in the official public JPG plan archive, including eight complete multi-level home layouts, seven plot group drawings, the community zoning/type sheets and master plan. Eight built-up totals were verified directly from the original panels.

unavailable: An exact gate entrance point and a complete plot-specific area schedule were not established. Danube website asset redistribution requires separate permission.
